messages:
Renee Park: Quick heads-up 1 — Cobalt.AI approved a short customer story. They reported ~3.8x P50 improvement and ~25% infra savings after moving to Redwood Dedicated. Can we scope interview and approvals?

Owen Blake: Nice. Who's the contact and quote cadence?

Renee Park: Contact is Marcus Lee (VP Infra). He do a 20-min tech interview and a 1-2 sentence on-record quote. Happy to provide a logo and headshot.

Sofia Martinez: I can run the interview. Thurs afternoon works. Will capture a short clip for social.

Eli Zhao: I'll pull graphs and a small table (p50/p95 before/after) and redact any internal IDs. ETA Tue morning.

Renee Park: Key messaging: 3.8x P50, 25% cost savings via batching + KV cache, simpler rollouts with Dedicated pools. Avoid naming previous vendors or instance SKUs.

Owen Blake: Drafted two hero lines for A/B: A) "Cobalt.AI sped up inference 3.8x with Redwood Dedicated." B) "Predictable low-latency at scale: Cobalt.AI's migration." Thoughts?

Sofia Martinez: B for site, A for dev channels.

Renee Park: Legal check incoming 
 — I'll submit quote + redacted screenshots. @legal-bot please review.

legal-bot: Received. Please ensure no PII and avoid comparative claims naming competitors. Turnaround ~48 hours. Send logo release for brand usage.

Renee Park: Marcus sent logo release in email thread. Uploading to Drive.

campaign-bot: Added campaign tag: campaign=cobalt-q4, publish_window=2025-03-02_to_2025-03-09, assets=case_study,webinar, tracked utm params set.

Owen Blake: I'll prepare the landing copy and two social variants (dev + exec). Also propose a short gated appendix for high-intent leads.

Eli Zhao: Uploaded redacted visuals and a simple table:
Metric | Before | After
P50 latency | 160ms | 42ms
P95 latency | 680ms | 130ms
Cost | baseline | -25%

Sofia Martinez: Sent interview questions to Marcus and scheduled Thurs 3pm PST. Will record and share transcript.

legal-bot: Clearance granted with required redactions. Approval ID LEG-2025-214. You are clear to publish once copy is finalized.

Renee Park: Proposed timeline:
- Tue 2025-02-25: final assets in Drive
- Thu 2025-02-27: design + legal QA
- Mon 2025-03-03: publish case study + social drip
- Wed 2025-03-05: webinar with Marcus (guest)

campaign-bot: Lead routing rules set: trials -> trials@redwood.ai, enterprise -> enterprise-sales@redwood.ai, tag: source=case-cobalt, region=apac. Gated leads -> enterprise-sales.

Owen Blake: Saving final copy to Drive. Please paste live URL here once published so we can close the thread.

Renee Park: Thanks all 
 — will post publish checklist when legal confirms assets.
